o1: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II transcription cofactor activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-positive bacterium; regulation of protein catabolic process; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; vulval fate specification; and Ras protein signal transduction. Is part of mediator complex. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; P5.p hermaphrodite; P6.p hermaphrodite; and vulval cell. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 18. Orthologous to human MED23 (mediator complex subunit 23).
